title: Research + implement: Rates API thin client

brief.objective: Implement a thin HTTP client for the sample FX rates endpoint with timeout and typed response.
brief.whyItMatters: Integration code should be isolated, testable, and fail loudly on network timeouts before it touches business logic.
doneCriteria: Timeout defaults to 3000ms and is overridable
boundaries: Do not add a new framework
Do not hardcode production API keys
brief.returnFormat: Summary + risks + file list + test output
